# `base/action-menu`

A row, card or header offers the same set of actions repeatedly and the overflow must collapse consistently.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A row, card or header offers the same set of actions repeatedly and the overflow must collapse consistently.
- **Avoid when:** You are building a bespoke menu anatomy, or the trigger is a right-click.
- **Consider instead:** `base/dropdown-menu`, `base/context-menu`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { ActionButtons } from "themelia-ui/base/action-menu"
import "themelia-ui/base/action-menu.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/buttons`, `base/dropdown-menu`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

| `actions` | yes | `readonly ActionDefinition[]` | The same definitions, side by side rather than collapsed into a menu. |

### `ActionMenu`

Kind: callable.

Overflow commands for a page, a card, a table or a row — one component so grouping,
destructive ordering, checkbox rows and links behave the same everywhere.

```text
({ actions, label, icon, strings, buttonProps, align, side, contentClassName, width, minWidth, maxWidth, closeOnSelect, labelVisibility, preserveOrder, renderLink, renderTrigger, }: ActionMenuProps) => import("react").JSX.Element | null
```

### `ActionMenuLabelVisibility`

Kind: type.

```text
"visible" | "responsive" | "hidden"
```

### `ActionMenuProps`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `actions` | yes | `readonly ActionDefinition[]` | Commands to offer. Destructive entries move last unless `preserveOrder` is set. |
| `label` | no | `string` | Trigger text. Omit for an icon-only trigger — `strings.trigger` names it then. |
| `icon` | no | `ActionIcon` | Trigger glyph. Defaults to the vertical ellipsis. |
| `strings` | no | `Partial<ActionMenuStrings>` | Overrides this menu's own copy. |
| `buttonProps` | no | `Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Button>, "children">` |  |
| `align` | no | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` |  |
| `side` | no | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` |  |
| `contentClassName` | no | `string` |  |
| `width` | no | `string \| number \| "trigger"` | Fixed surface width, any CSS length, or `"trigger"` to match the trigger. Left<br>unset the menu sizes to its widest row. |
| `minWidth` | no | `string \| number` |  |
| `maxWidth` | no | `string \| number` | Ceiling for the content-sized default: a reading measure, so one long label doesn't widen every row. |
| `closeOnSelect` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `labelVisibility` | no | `ActionMenuLabelVisibility` |  |
| `preserveOrder` | no | `boolean` | Keeps the incoming order instead of moving destructive entries last. |
| `renderLink` | no | `ActionLinkRenderer` | Routes `href` actions through the app's router, keeping this framework-agnostic. |
| `renderTrigger` | no | `ComponentProps<typeof DropdownMenuTrigger>["render"]` | Replaces the trigger entirely — an account block, a sidebar row, a tab. For different<br>words on a plain button, use `label` and `icon`. |

### `ActionPlacement`

Kind: type.

Where an action renders when a set is split between buttons and a menu.

```text
"auto" | "inline" | "menu"
```

### `ActionPredicate`

Kind: type.

A flag, or a question asked of the subject the action is bound to.

```text
boolean | ((context: TContext) => boolean)
```

### `ContextAction`

Kind: interface.

An action bound to a subject — a table row, a board card, an activity, a record. An
`ActionDefinition` whose handler and predicates take the subject; table, board and
activity actions extend it, and `resolveContextActions` resolves them.

Extends: `Omit<ActionDefinition, "onClick" | "visible" | "disabled">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `onClick` | no | `(context: TContext) => void` |  |
| `visible` | no | `ActionPredicate<TContext>` | `false`, or a predicate returning false, omits the action for that subject. |
| `disabled` | no | `ActionPredicate<TContext>` |  |
| `placement` | no | `ActionPlacement` | Forces this entry to one side when the set is split between buttons and a menu: `menu`<br>keeps it out of the button row, `inline` pins it there, `auto` lets the renderer decide. |

### `ContextActionSource`

Kind: type.

A fixed list, or one computed per subject.

```text
readonly ContextAction<TContext>[] | ((context: TContext) => readonly ContextAction<TContext>[])
```

### `defaultActionMenuStrings`

Kind: const.

```text
ActionMenuStrings
```

### `resolveContextActions`

Kind: callable.

Runs the predicates against `context` and binds each handler to it.

```text
(source: ContextActionSource<TContext> | undefined, context: TContext, options?: ResolveContextActionsOptions) => ResolvedAction[]
```

### `ResolveContextActionsOptions`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `onAction` | no | `(id: string) => void` | Called after an action's own handler, with its id, for surfaces reporting all actions through one callback. |
| `stripHref` | no | `boolean` | Drops `href` instead of rendering a link — for tables, where `href` is data the handler routes with. |

### `ResolvedAction`

Kind: type.

A resolved entry: a plain `ActionDefinition` that still knows where it wants to go.

```text
ActionDefinition & { placement?: ActionPlacement; }
```

### `splitActions`

Kind: callable.

Splits a set into buttons and overflow: `inline` entries are always buttons, `menu`
entries always overflow, the rest fill up to `max` in order. No `max`: all are buttons.

```text
(actions: readonly TAction[], max?: number) => { inline: TAction[]; overflow: TAction[]; }
```

### ActionMenu

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<ActionMenu
  actions={[
    { label: "Edit", icon: PencilIcon, onClick: … },
    { label: "Archive", icon: ArchiveIcon, onClick: …, group: true },
    { label: "Delete", icon: TrashIcon, onClick: …, tone: "destructive" },

/>
```

### Destructive last

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
const declared = [
  { label: "Delete", tone: "destructive", onClick: … },
  { label: "Edit", onClick: … },
  { label: "Duplicate", onClick: … },
]

<ActionMenu actions={declared} />
<ActionMenu actions={declared} preserveOrder />
```

### Width and row slots

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<ActionMenu actions={actions} maxWidth="18rem" />
<ActionMenu actions={actions} width={280} />
<ActionMenu actions={actions} width="trigger" label="Matches trigger" />

// Rows take slots, so the label is the only part that gives way:
{ label: "Duplicate", icon: CopyIcon, shortcut: "⌘D" }
{ label: "Export", description: "CSV, one row per invoice" }
```

<ActionButtons actions={toolbar} max={2} />

### Actions that depend on a record

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
const actions: ContextAction<Invoice>[] = [
  { id: "send", label: "Send reminder", visible: (i) => !i.paid, placement: "inline" },
  { id: "edit", label: "Edit", disabled: (i) => i.locked },
  { id: "delete", label: "Delete", tone: "destructive", placement: "menu" },
]

<ActionButtons actions={resolveContextActions(actions, invoice)} max={2} />
```
